$comment: Voorgestelde landingspagina's (richting A, 'probeer direct': de pagina opent met een echte, nagekeken examenopgave en één knop 'Start gratis' naar het platform; geen prijzen). De zaterdagrun (/seo-weekly) zet hier elke week twee à drie varianten bij en werkt de status bij; ze verschijnen als rij op /admin/seo, achter het filter Landing pages. Ids nooit hergebruiken; een idee dat afvalt krijgt status 'dismissed' en blijft staan. Teksten zijn Engels (besluit eigenaar, 26-10): ze zijn voor de eigenaar.

checks: A working exam item from our own reviewed content is in the hero
Not a near-copy of another landing page (a different item type or a different question)
Every fact comes from data/skills.ts or SEO/facts.md
rules.focus: New pages for specific searches that no practice page answers yet (retakes, a failed part, a deadline). Not upgrades of the existing practice pages (owner, 13-11).

items.title: Gratis oefenexamen inburgering
items.variant: Hero opens on Lezen A2 question lz-2 (already reviewed, also used on the homepage demo). Under it, one tile per published part that starts exam 1.
items.evidence: "inburgering oefenen" had 204 impressions at position 9 and "inburgeringsexamen oefenen" 32 at position 11 (GSC, W45). Both land on /nl and /nl/oefenen; neither starts with something to do.
items.competitor: The rest of this SERP is spam PDFs and inburgering.org /nl/free/exam.
items.why: Our strongest query, already on page 1. A first question in the hero should lift clicks into practice without a new URL.
items.dismissed_note: Owner, 13-11: the practice pages already exist; landing pages are for new, specific searches.

items.title: Spreken A2 oefenen
items.variant: Hero opens on Spreken A2 exam 1, opdracht 1 (the neighbour asks where you live) with the recorder. After recording: the model answer and "Verder met opdracht 2".
items.evidence: 110 impressions in Aug and Sep (page audit). The page lists ten exam slots but has no first step.
items.competitor: inburgering.org/nl/speaking-a2 shows a free sample before the price.
items.why: Speaking is the part people fear most and can practise least on their own. A recorder you can use at once is something a guide page can't offer.
items.dismissed_note: Owner, 13-11: the practice pages already exist; landing pages are for new, specific searches.

items.title: Gezakt voor één onderdeel? Oefen alleen dat
items.variant: Hero opens on the working demo with four tabs (Lezen, Luisteren, Schrijven, Spreken); each tab ends in 'Start <part> gratis' to exam 1. Below: exam 1 per part for A2 and B1, five DUO facts with sources, Amber, FAQ.
items.evidence: No query measured yet; we don't rank for it. The research of 13-11 found no sales page for retaking one part in Google NL, only guides and government PDFs.
items.why: Someone who failed one part knows exactly what to practise, and our modules are per part. The rules on retakes must come from DUO via SEO/facts.md first.
items.note: Built 13-11, reviewed by Amber and live 16-11: indexable (nl only), in the sitemap, linked twice from /nl/blog/inburgeringsexamen-zakken-herkansen.

items.title: Voorbeeldvragen inburgeringsexamen
items.variant: Hero opens on Lezen A2 taster item lz-4 (answerable, with explanation). Below: Luisteren lu-4 with the real recording (transcript after a correct answer), the Schrijven A2 exam-1 e-mail task and the Spreken A2 prompt (task only, never the model answer), an A2 format table linking to exam 1 per part, Amber, FAQ.
items.evidence: "inburgeringsvragen" had 53 impressions; Google showed /nl/oefenen at position 82 (planned page in scripts/seo-agent/pages.mjs).
items.competitor: Sample-question pages in this SERP are guides (inburgering.org); none lets you answer on the page without an account.
items.why: Tool intent with our own reviewed exam items: something an AI Overview cannot replace and a competitor cannot copy. Different items and layout from /herexamen.
items.note: Built 16-11 at app/[locale]/(main)/voorbeeldvragen/page.tsx. noindex and out of the sitemap until Amber has reviewed it (seo-agent/briefs/2026-11-16-voorbeeldvragen.md). Go live in week 48 at the earliest (one new URL per week; /herexamen is this week).
